metadata.description: Exchange rate policy for Cambodia customs duty and tax calculations
metadata.official_source_url: https://www.mef.gov.kh or customs.gov.kh exchange rate page
metadata.api_status: Not yet implemented - currently using CSV file. API integration planned for future release.

policy.rationale: Use official MEF exchange rate tables from CSV file (not dynamic API) to ensure reproducible calculations for audit compliance
policy.current_implementation: CSV file parsing from MEF-scraped data
policy.update_frequency: Manual update when new CSV file is provided (future: daily automated scrape from MEF website)
policy.regulatory_basis: Customs valuation rules require official published rates, not market rates

rate_selection_rules.description: Always use the exchange rate published for the customs declaration date
rate_selection_rules.action: Look up rate with exact declaration date in exchange_rates.json

rate_selection_rules.description: If user does NOT provide declaration date, use the latest available exchange rate
rate_selection_rules.action: Use the most recent (latest) exchange rate file available to give user an estimate of tax cost

constraints.note: This is for estimation purposes when user is unsure of import date

rate_selection_rules.applies_when: User does not provide declaration_date (optional field)

rate_selection_rules.description: If currency not found in recent rates, reject calculation
rate_selection_rules.action: Return error requesting manual rate or rate correction

rate_lookup_logic.step_1: Check if user provided declaration_date in input
rate_lookup_logic.step_2: If declaration_date NOT provided, use latest available exchange rate CSV file for estimation
rate_lookup_logic.step_3: Normalize currency code to ISO 4217 3-letter uppercase
rate_lookup_logic.step_4: Query CSV file: exchange_rates_selenium_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv for matching currency code in 'Unit' column
rate_lookup_logic.step_5: Extract rate from 'Rate' column (KHR value, e.g., '4022KHR')
rate_lookup_logic.step_6: Parse rate value (remove 'KHR' suffix, handle comma-formatted numbers)
rate_lookup_logic.step_7: If currency still not found, return error with available currencies list

base_currency.name: Cambodian Riel
base_currency.description: All calculations performed and results expressed in KHR

conversion_path.foreign_to_khr: Direct lookup: 1 [CURRENCY] = X KHR (from exchange_rate table)
conversion_path.foreign_to_foreign: Not directly supported - must convert through USD or KHR

exchange_rate_itself.description: CRITICAL: Exchange rates are used EXACTLY as published by MEF
exchange_rate_itself.constraint: DO NOT round exchange rates before applying them

conversion_result.description: After conversion, round UP to nearest 100

validation_rules.constraint: Alert if outside range, but allow override

validation_rules.description: All rates published on same date should come from same MEF source
validation_rules.constraint: Log if rates from different source files

validation_rules.description: Currency codes must be valid ISO 4217

implementation_for_calculator: Load CSV file: exchange_rates_selenium_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv at service startup or cache for 24 hours
Parse CSV columns: No, Currency, Unit (e.g., '1USD'), Rate (e.g., '1.0000USD'), Unit (e.g., '1USD'), Rate (e.g., '4022KHR')
Index rates by currency code (extracted from Unit column) for fast lookup
Extract rate_to_khr value from 'Rate' column (rightmost column), removing 'KHR' suffix and parsing comma-formatted numbers
Check if declaration_date is provided by user - it is OPTIONAL
If declaration_date NOT provided, use latest available CSV file to give user an estimate
Log which exchange rate was used (currency, rate, effective_date from filename)
For estimation cases (no declaration date), clearly label result as 'estimate based on current rates'
Future: Replace with API call to MEF website when API becomes available

data_update_process.trigger: New CSV file provided by operations team (Future: Scheduled scrape from MEF website at 08:00 UTC)
data_update_process.action: Place new CSV file in: data/processed/structured/exchange_rates_selenium_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS.csv with timestamp in filename

data_update_process.description: When new exchange rates are available, export to CSV and place in data/processed/structured/
Keep old CSV files - NEVER delete or overwrite existing date files
data_update_process.reason: Maintain audit trail of what rates existed at declaration time; enable recalculation of past declarations

data_update_process.description: Keep raw CSV files with timestamps in filename

data_update_process.future_automation: When API becomes available, configure automatic daily scrape from MEF at 08:00 UTC
data_update_process.alert_condition: No new update for 2+ consecutive days (when automated)

parsing_notes: Extract currency code from 'Unit' column (matches Unit_Foreign)
Extract rate to KHR from 'Rate_2' column (matches Rate_KHR)

scenario_1.description: Calculate CIF value for item priced in USD on Feb 19, 2026

scenario_2.description: Calculate customs value for Thai Baht on Feb 19, 2026

scenario_3.description: User does NOT provide declaration date - wants estimate of how much tax they need to pay
scenario_3.calculation: No declaration date provided, use latest available CSV (2026-02-19): 500 EUR × 4784 KHR/EUR = 2392000 KHR

compliance_notes: Exchange rates must be from official MEF source (Ministry of Economy and Finance)
For customs audit purposes, document which rate table (date) was used
If importer disputes rate, official MEF published rate on declaration date is authoritative
Historical rates must be preserved - do not delete old exchange rate files
System must be able to reproduce calculations using historical rates for past declarations
references: Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF) official exchange rate publications
See rounding_rules.json for how converted amounts should be rounded
See formula_registry.json for formulas that use exchange_rate parameter
current_implementation_notes: CURRENT STATUS (as of 2026-02-19): Using CSV file-based lookup
CSV Columns: No, Currency, Unit, Rate, Unit, Rate (rightmost is KHR conversion)
To update rates: Place new CSV file in data/processed/structured/ with timestamp filename
future_api_integration: FUTURE: Direct MEF API integration (not yet available)
